description: This Java class represents the data model for an interoperation quote response in the Fineract platform. It extends InteropResponseData and encapsulates details such as quote code, fees, commissions, and associated builder methods for creating instances with various parameter configurations.

classes.name: InteropQuoteResponseData
classes.description: A final class representing the quotation response data in interoperation workflows, including quote identifiers, fees, and associated metadata.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static factory methods to create instances of InteropQuoteResponseData with different sets of parameters.
